entries.title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
entries.read: Abstract, introduction, §§2–3.4, §4.1 and the beginning of §4.2; targeted code ranges listed separately.
entries.not_read: Full experimental tables, all appendices and prompts; no model execution.
entries.finding: Learns numeric 6D insertion from point clouds and relation instructions using ordinary autoregressive likelihood; planner and instruction generator provide a generation loop. Its primary quantitative task is insertion, not professional activity-dependent whole-home preference.
entries.method_implication: Point-cloud grounding, geometry-conditioned placement and plan/place/verify are existing capabilities. Our hypothesis must concern when a design decision applies, beyond better pose prediction.

entries.title: Scene layout via conceptual design
entries.read: §§3–6 (PDF pp. 3–6), related-work passage and beginning of §7; equation/algorithm text.
entries.not_read: All quantitative results, supplement, implementation, figures as images.
entries.finding: Hierarchical requirements become geometric constraints. ComputeIIS-derived modification plans are explained semantically and an LLM selects a conflict resolution; forced constraint removal supports termination.
entries.method_implication: Selecting a constraint or upstream decision to change after feedback already has direct scene-layout precedent. Termination by removing constraints must not be confused with retaining all user requirements.

entries.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
entries.read: This turn: targeted §3.1 paragraphs on trajectory consolidation, action-conditioned reasoning and perturbation supervision. Earlier wider reads are not claimed again.
entries.not_read: No new full-paper or full-repository re-read, no native execution.
entries.finding: The published method already uses observation–reasoning–action supervision; reasoning is constructed with the retained target action available.
entries.method_implication: Legitimate teacher supervision is not test-time evidence. Merely adding a reason before a tool action is insufficient differentiation.

entries.title: DesignAgent3D: Interactive 3D Scene Editing via Designer-like Multimodal Reasoning
entries.not_read: Full method, experiments, code and publication status verification.
entries.finding: The stated task is interactive, geometry-preserving appearance editing of reconstructed scenes, using clarification and object grounding.
entries.method_implication: Relevant for intent grounding, but this overview does not establish it as a direct trained furniture-layout decision baseline.

scope: Targeted primary-source review, not exhaustive novelty clearance; public Git metadata/code downloads are not paid model calls.
